description: Southern India, daytime birth. Primary regression chart: Moon late in Dhanu (Uttara Ashadha) gives a short Sun dasha balance, which exercises balance-at-birth. Lagna early in Karkataka keeps house cusps away from sign boundaries.

referenceSource.doctrine: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (R. Santhanam translation), C23_BPHS_Santhanam.pdf

locators.vimshottari: Ch.46 vv.12-16 (order, durations, balance at birth); Ch.51 vv.1-2 (sub-period formula)

review.note: Values recorded from this repository's own engine to detect drift. Not yet signed off against an independent published chart; see fixtures/README.md.
